abstract: Biomarkers for immune checkpoint inhibitors have largely treated the tumor immune microenvironment as a fixed property. In this issue of Cancer Cell, Lin et al. assemble a longitudinal pan-cancer single-cell atlas and show that the direction of immune-state remodeling during therapy is more informative than baseline composition.
